description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa in upper-left living area facing inward toward a TV/coffee table; dining table set near kitchen counter. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); bathroom (shower and toilet). Two bathrooms — two people can shower simultaneously, parallel morning and evening routines possible. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child; two adults sharing independently — each with private bathroom access. Not suitable for: large families needing more than two bedrooms; people requiring a home office with dedicated natural light; those wanting a bathtub for bathing children; users needing generous accessible/wheelchair circulation given the compartmentalised corridor layout.
